description: This file implements methods related to device identification in a plugin for the WPEFramework. It includes registration and unregistration of properties, and provides a method to obtain device identification data.

classes.name: DeviceIdentification
classes.description: A class that manages device identification properties and API endpoints within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all the properties of the DeviceIdentification class.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all the properties registered by DeviceIdentification.
